_comment: Per table rules for the leaderboards, for the tables whose scores are not found or not ended right by the heuristics (see src/core/ScoreTracker.h).
A rule applies to the tables whose file name contains 'file', or which run the ROM 'rom'. Users can add their own in score-rules.json in the preferences folder.

Fields: disable (no scores recorded), source (pinmame, b2s, ultradmd, script, highscore), scores / players / inGame / gameOver (names of script variables), scoreBase (0 or 1, first index of the scores array), gameOnSolenoid (PinMAME solenoid on while a game is played, for machines whose memory map has no game over flag).

rules._table: Masters of the Universe (custom): its scoreboard always shows 2 players, its scores and game flag have their own names
The Walking Dead (Stern SAM): no game over flag in the memory map, flipper enable 'GameOn' solenoid of PinMAME
